source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.before: Pursue love, and earnestly desire the spiritual things, but especially that you may prophesy.
key_decisions.after: Pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially that you may prophesy.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Pursue love, and earnestly desire the spiritual things, but especially that you may prophesy.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves divine address, lack of comprehension, and mysteries.
key_decisions.before: For the one speaking in a tongue does not speak to men but to God; for no one understands, but in spirit he speaks mysteries.
key_decisions.after: For the one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to people but to God, since no one understands; by the Spirit that person speaks mysteries.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the one speaking in a tongue does not speak to men but to God; for no one understands, but in spirit he speaks mysteries.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Paul's desire, ranking, exception, and purpose.
key_decisions.before: Now I wish that you all spoke in tongues, but even more that you would prophesy; and greater is the one who prophesies than the one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the church may receive building up.
key_decisions.after: Now I want all of you to speak in tongues, but even more to prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets so that the church may be built up.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now I wish that you all spoke in tongues, but even more that you would prophesy; and greater is the one who prophesies than the one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the church may receive building up.

key_decisions.before: If then I do not know the meaning of the voice, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker a foreigner to me.
key_decisions.after: So if I do not know the meaning of the language, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker a foreigner to me.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If then I do not know the meaning of the voice, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker a foreigner to me.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves zeal redirected to communal good.
key_decisions.before: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual things, seek that you may abound for the building up of the church.
key_decisions.after: So also with you: since you are eager for spiritual manifestations, seek to excel in building up the church.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual things, seek that you may abound for the building up of the church.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves outsider, Amen, and comprehension issue.
key_decisions.before: Otherwise, if you bless in spirit, how will the one occupying the place of the uninstructed say “Amen” at your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
key_decisions.after: Otherwise, if you offer praise by the spirit, how can someone in the place of an outsider say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since that person does not know what you are saying?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Otherwise, if you bless in spirit, how will the one occupying the place of the uninstructed say “Amen” at your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?

key_decisions.before: but in the church I prefer to speak five words with my mind so that I may instruct others also, rather than ten thousand words in a tongue.
key_decisions.after: But in church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but in the church I prefer to speak five words with my mind so that I may instruct others also, rather than ten thousand words in a tongue.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps foreign speech and refused hearing.
key_decisions.before: In the law it is written, “By people of other tongues and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people, and even so they will not listen to me,” says the Lord.
key_decisions.after: In the law it is written: “By people of other tongues and by the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, yet even then they will not listen to me,” says the Lord.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: In the law it is written, “By people of other tongues and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people, and even so they will not listen to me,” says the Lord.

key_decisions.before: So then tongues are for a sign, not to believers but to unbelievers; but prophecy is not for unbelievers but for believers.
key_decisions.after: So tongues are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers, while prophecy is not for unbelievers but for believers.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So then tongues are for a sign, not to believers but to unbelievers; but prophecy is not for unbelievers but for believers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps whole assembly and visitor reaction.
key_decisions.before: So if the whole church comes together and all speak in tongues, and uninstructed or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are out of your mind?
key_decisions.after: Therefore, if the whole church gathers together and everyone speaks in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say you are out of your minds?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore if the whole church comes together and all speak in tongues, and uninstructed or unbelievers enter, will they not say that you are out of your mind?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps disclosure, bodily worship, and confession.
key_decisions.before: the secrets of his heart become manifest; and so falling on his face he will worship God, declaring that God is truly among you.
key_decisions.after: The secrets of that person's heart become evident, and so, falling facedown, the person will worship God and declare, “God is truly among you.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: the secrets of his heart become manifest; and so falling on his face he will worship God, declaring that God is truly among you.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves participatory variety and governing purpose.
key_decisions.before: What then, brothers and sisters? When you come together, each has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let everything be done for building up.
key_decisions.after: What then, brothers and sisters? When you gather, each one has a psalm, a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. Let everything be done for building up.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: What then, brothers? When you come together, each has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has a tongue, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for building up.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps exact limits, sequence, and interpretation.
key_decisions.before: If someone speaks in a tongue, let it be by two or at most three, and in turn, and let one interpret;
key_decisions.after: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let there be two, or at most three, each in turn, and let one person interpret.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let it be by two or at most three, and in turn, and let one interpret;

key_decisions.before: and the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
key_decisions.after: And prophets' spirits are subject to prophets,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and the spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps theological ground and broad church frame.
key_decisions.before: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace. As in all the churches of the holy ones,
key_decisions.after: for God is not a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the churches of the saints. As in all the churches of the holy ones,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace. As in all the churches of the holy ones,

key_decisions.rationale: Translates the pinned instruction directly without erasing tension with 11:5.
key_decisions.before: let the women keep silent in the churches; for they are not permitted to speak, but let them be in submission, as also the law says.
key_decisions.after: Women should remain silent in the churches, for they are not permitted to speak but should be in submission, as the law also says.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: let the women keep silent in the churches; for they are not permitted to speak, but let them be in submission, as also the law says.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains marriage-specific direction and shame language.
key_decisions.before: And if they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.
key_decisions.after: If they want to learn something, they should ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves claimed authority and discernment test.
key_decisions.before: If someone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things I write to you are a command of the Lord.
key_decisions.after: If anyone thinks they are a prophet or spiritual, that person should recognize that what I write to you is the Lord's command.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If anyone thinks he is a prophet or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things I write to you are a command of the Lord.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows pinned passive reading and reciprocal wordplay.

key_decisions.after: But if anyone refuses to recognize this, that person is not recognized.
